# pipeline/configs

**In one sentence:** one dataclass per pipeline step holding that step's settings (thresholds, model ids, toggles) with their defaults and validation.

## Why it exists
Each `<step>.yaml` in a project is loaded into one of these classes, so steps get typed,
checked settings instead of raw dicts.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `import_config.py` | `ImportConfig` — ImportStep has no user tunables. |
| `upscale_config.py` | `UpscaleConfig` — target size, which images to upscale, SeedVR2 paths/model/device options, hallucination SSIM threshold. Imports SeedVR2 catalog from `steps/upscale`. |
| `quality_gate_config.py` | `QualityGateConfig` plus `ScorerEntry` (one scorer rule, e.g. `min_side lt 1024`). |
| `curate_config.py` | `CurateConfig` — duplicate distance, coverage embedding model, PCA/UMAP settings, `skip_clip`. |
| `vae_gate_config.py` | `VaeGateConfig` — VAE model, diff/blur/threshold tuning and which preview images to write. |
| `caption_bbox_config.py` | `CaptionBboxConfig` — caption model and task, strategy, VRAM tier, prompts, domain brief. |
| `caption_verifier_config.py` | `CaptionVerifierConfig` — text-to-image check model, quantization, dtype, offload. |
| `audit_config.py` | `AuditConfig` — caption length limits, pairing/corrupt/resolution checks. |
| `bucket_pools_check_config.py` | `BucketPoolsCheckConfig` — resolution buckets, thin-bucket threshold, cache mode. |
| `export_config.py` | `ExportConfig` — `target_dir`, where the final dataset is written. |

## How it works
- `pipeline/configuration.py` links each step type to its config class (`step_config_class`).
- `project/base.py` builds the class from the step's YAML data; `__post_init__` validates values.
- UI edits are applied on top by `project/config_schema/overrides.py`, which re-runs that validation.

## Who uses it
- `project/base.py`, `pipeline/configuration.py`, `settings/payload.py`
- Every adapter in `invoke/` and every `steps/*/step.py`
- Tests: `tests/project/test_config.py`, `tests/steps/*/test_config.py`, many step tests

## Good to know
- `__init__.py`'s docstring says callers "keep importing from `project.configs`", but no
  `project/configs` module exists any more; everyone imports `prepare_lora_kit.pipeline.configs`.
